description: Port of the Second Chance Minecraft mod by zoeytheegoist

mods.name: Second Chance Forge
mods.description:
A mod designed for better accessibility, while still managing to stay within the frame of Vanilla.
This mod adds a feature that allows you to stay at half a heart when you would've been one shot, and a feature to allow you to jump for a few seconds after falling off a block!
Both features are toggleable through the config.

This is a Forge port of the original Fabric mod by Zoeytheegoist.

Coder:
- HellionGames
- SwanX1
- CaelTheQuail

Original:
- Zoeytheegoist

Special Thanks:
- Nekomaster1000 for the Logo Render
